description: Read retained property versions with zero based and named selectors
code:
class Student
student = Student()
student.name = "Can"
student.name = "Daphne"
student.name = "Merve"
assert(student.name@0, "Can")
assert(student.name@1, "Daphne")
assert(student.name@last, "Merve")
assert(student.name@previous, "Daphne")
student.name@first

description: Keep reactive histories live while equal writes add no entries
code:
input = 2
amount = input * 3
original = amount@first
recent = amount@last
before = amount@previous
input = 4
input = 4
assert(original, 6)
assert(recent, 12)
assert(before, 6)
assert(amount@2, null)
[original, recent, before]

description: Rollback failed state versions and reset a deleted slot
code:
status = "ready"
try:
    status = "discarded"
    throw "ABORT"
catch error:
    assert(error, "ABORT")
status = "done"
assert(status@first, "ready")
assert(status@previous, "ready")
assert(status@2, null)
delete status
status = "fresh"
assert(status@first, "fresh")
assert(status@previous, null)
status@last

description: Historical object references retain normal mutable identity
code:
first = {label: "old", first: "ordinary"}
second = {label: "new"}
selected = first
selected = second
selected@first.label = "updated"
assert(first.label, "updated")
assert(selected@first.first, "ordinary")
assert(selected@last.label, "new")
assert(selected@previous, first)
[first.label, selected.label]
